    40→def extract_finding_citations(text: str, valid_ids: set[str]) -> set[str]:
    41→    """Extract finding IDs cited in free text.
    42→
    43→    Matches full finding IDs (e.g. ``review::abcdef12``) or bare 8+ char
    44→    hex suffixes that correspond to a known finding.
    45→    """
    46→    cited: set[str] = set()
    47→    # Match full finding IDs
    48→    for match in FINDING_ID_RE.finditer(text):
    49→        candidate = match.group()
    50→        if candidate in valid_ids:
    51→            cited.add(candidate)
    52→    # Match 8+ char hex suffixes
    53→    for token in re.findall(r"[0-9a-f]{8,}", text):
    54→        for valid_id in valid_ids:
    55→            if valid_id.endswith("::" + token):
    56→                cited.add(valid_id)
    57→                break
    58→    return cited

   184→def collect_synthesis_input(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> SynthesisInput:
   185→    """Gather all data needed for the synthesis LLM prompt."""
   186→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   187→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   188→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   189→    epics = synthesis_clusters(plan)
   190→
   191→    open_review: dict[str, dict] = {}
   192→    open_mechanical: dict[str, dict] = {}
   193→    for fid, f in findings.items():
   194→        if f.get("status") != "open":
   195→            continue
   196→        if f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns"):
   197→            open_review[fid] = f
   198→        else:
   199→            open_mechanical[fid] = f
   200→
   201→    synthesized_ids = set(meta.get("synthesized_ids", []))
   202→    current_review_ids = set(open_review.keys())
   203→    new_since = current_review_ids - synthesized_ids
   204→    resolved_since = synthesized_ids - current_review_ids
   205→    previously_dismissed = list(meta.get("dismissed_ids", []))
   206→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   207→
   208→    # Resolved finding objects (for REFLECT stage)
   209→    resolved_finding_objs = {
   210→        fid: findings[fid] for fid in resolved_since if fid in findings
   211→    }
   212→
   213→    # Completed clusters since last synthesis completion
   214→    last_completed = meta.get("last_completed_at", "")
   215→    all_completed: list[dict] = plan.get("completed_clusters", [])
   216→    if last_completed:
   217→        recent_completed = [
   218→            c for c in all_completed
   219→            if c.get("completed_at", "") > last_completed
   220→        ]
   221→    else:
   222→        recent_completed = list(all_completed)
   223→
   224→    return SynthesisInput(
   225→        open_findings=open_review,
   226→        mechanical_findings=open_mechanical,
   227→        existing_epics=dict(epics),
   228→        dimension_scores=state.get("dimension_scores", {}),
   229→        new_since_last=new_since,
   230→        resolved_since_last=resolved_since,
   231→        previously_dismissed=previously_dismissed,
   232→        synthesis_version=version,
   233→        resolved_findings=resolved_finding_objs,
   234→        completed_clusters=recent_completed,
   235→    )

   242→_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   243→You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Your goal is to produce
   244→a coherent, prioritized strategy to address ALL open review findings.
   245→
   246→Your plan should:
   247→- Cluster findings by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
   248→- Give each cluster (epic) a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   249→- Order epics by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
   250→- Dismiss findings that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
   251→- Mark which epics are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
   252→- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
   253→- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all findings coherently
   254→
   255→Available directions for epics: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
   256→
   257→Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
   258→- `desloppify plan queue` — view all items in priority order
   259→- `desloppify plan focus epic/<name>` — focus the queue on one epic
   260→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   261→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   262→- `desloppify plan done <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   263→- `desloppify plan move <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   264→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   265→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   266→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review findings
   267→
   268→Your output defines the ENTIRE work plan. Findings not assigned to any epic
   269→will remain in the queue as individual items. Dismissed findings will be
   270→removed from the queue with your stated reason.
   271→
   272→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   273→{
   274→  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   275→  "epics": [
   276→    {
   277→      "name": "slug-name",
   278→      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   279→      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   280→      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   281→      "finding_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   282→      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   283→      "agent_safe": true,
   284→      "dependency_order": 1,
   285→      "action_steps": ["step 1", "step 2"],
   286→      "status": "pending"
   287→    }
   288→  ],
   289→  "dismissed_findings": [
   290→    {"finding_id": "id", "reason": "why this finding doesn't make sense"}
   291→  ],
   292→  "contradiction_notes": [
   293→    {"kept": "finding_id", "dismissed": "finding_id", "reason": "why"}
   294→  ],
   295→  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is"
   296→}
   297→"""

   299→
   300→def build_synthesis_prompt(si: SynthesisInput) -> str:
   301→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all finding data."""
   302→    parts: list[str] = []
   303→
   304→    # Section: existing epics
   305→    if si.existing_epics:
   306→        parts.append("## Existing Epics (update these, don't recreate)")
   307→        for name, epic in sorted(si.existing_epics.items()):
   308→            status = epic.get("status", "pending")
   309→            thesis = epic.get("thesis", "")
   310→            direction = epic.get("direction", "")
   311→            fids = epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   312→            parts.append(
   313→                f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   314→                f"\n  Findings: {', '.join(fids[:10])}"
   315→                f"{'...' if len(fids) > 10 else ''}"
   316→            )
   317→        parts.append("")
   318→
   319→    # Section: what changed
   320→    if si.new_since_last:
   321→        parts.append(f"## New findings since last synthesis ({len(si.new_since_last)})")
   322→        for fid in sorted(si.new_since_last):
   323→            f = si.open_findings.get(fid, {})
   324→            parts.append(f"- {fid}: {f.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   325→        parts.append("")
   326→
   327→    if si.resolved_since_last:
   328→        parts.append(f"## Resolved since last synthesis ({len(si.resolved_since_last)})")
   329→        for fid in sorted(si.resolved_since_last):
   330→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   331→        parts.append("")
   332→
   333→    # Section: all open review findings
   334→    parts.append(f"## All open review findings ({len(si.open_findings)})")
   335→    for fid, f in sorted(si.open_findings.items()):
   336→        detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   337→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   338→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   339→        confidence = f.get("confidence", "medium")
   340→        file_path = f.get("file", "")
   341→        summary = f.get("summary", "")
   342→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {fid}")
   343→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   344→        if dimension:
   345→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   346→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   347→        if suggestion:
   348→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   349→    parts.append("")
   350→
   351→    # Section: dimension scores for context
   352→    if si.dimension_scores:
   353→        parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   354→        for name, data in sorted(si.dimension_scores.items()):
   355→            if isinstance(data, dict):
   356→                score = data.get("score", "?")
   357→                strict = data.get("strict", score)
   358→                issues = data.get("issues", 0)
   359→                parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   360→        parts.append("")
   361→
   362→    # Section: previously dismissed
   363→    if si.previously_dismissed:
   364→        parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(si.previously_dismissed)})")
   365→        parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   366→        for fid in si.previously_dismissed:
   367→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   368→        parts.append("")
   369→
   370→    return "\n".join(parts)

   377→def parse_synthesis_result(raw: dict, valid_ids: set[str]) -> SynthesisResult:
   378→    """Parse and validate raw LLM output into a SynthesisResult.
   379→
   380→    Invalid finding IDs are silently dropped from epics and dismissals.
   381→    """
   382→    strategy_summary = str(raw.get("strategy_summary", ""))
   383→
   384→    epics: list[dict] = []
   385→    for raw_epic in raw.get("epics", []):
   386→        if not isinstance(raw_epic, dict):
   387→            continue
   388→        name = str(raw_epic.get("name", "")).strip()
   389→        if not name:
   390→            continue
   391→        # Validate direction
   392→        direction = str(raw_epic.get("direction", "simplify")).strip()
   393→        if direction not in VALID_EPIC_DIRECTIONS:
   394→            direction = "simplify"
   395→        # Filter to valid finding IDs
   396→        finding_ids = [
   397→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   398→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   399→        ]
   400→        dismissed = [
   401→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("dismissed", [])
   402→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   403→        ]
   404→        action_steps = [
   405→            str(s) for s in raw_epic.get("action_steps", [])
   406→            if isinstance(s, str)
   407→        ]
   408→
   409→        epics.append({
   410→            "name": name,
   411→            "thesis": str(raw_epic.get("thesis", "")),
   412→            "direction": direction,
   413→            "root_cause": str(raw_epic.get("root_cause", "")),
   414→            "finding_ids": finding_ids,
   415→            "dismissed": dismissed,
   416→            "agent_safe": bool(raw_epic.get("agent_safe", False)),
   417→            "dependency_order": int(raw_epic.get("dependency_order", 999)),
   418→            "action_steps": action_steps,
   419→            "status": str(raw_epic.get("status", "pending")),
   420→        })
   421→
   422→    dismissed_findings: list[DismissedFinding] = []
   423→    for d in raw.get("dismissed_findings", []):
   424→        if not isinstance(d, dict):
   425→            continue
   426→        fid = str(d.get("finding_id", ""))
   427→        if fid in valid_ids:
   428→            dismissed_findings.append(
   429→                DismissedFinding(finding_id=fid, reason=str(d.get("reason", "")))
   430→            )
   431→
   432→    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = []
   433→    for c in raw.get("contradiction_notes", []):
   434→        if not isinstance(c, dict):
   435→            continue
   436→        contradiction_notes.append(ContradictionNote(
   437→            kept=str(c.get("kept", "")),
   438→            dismissed=str(c.get("dismissed", "")),
   439→            reason=str(c.get("reason", "")),
   440→        ))
   441→
   442→    priority_rationale = str(raw.get("priority_rationale", ""))
   443→
   444→    return SynthesisResult(
   445→        strategy_summary=strategy_summary,
   446→        epics=epics,
   447→        dismissed_findings=dismissed_findings,
   448→        contradiction_notes=contradiction_notes,
   449→        priority_rationale=priority_rationale,
   450→    )

   453→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

   455→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   456→
   457→def apply_synthesis_to_plan(
   458→    plan: PlanModel,
   459→    state: StateModel,
   460→    synthesis: SynthesisResult,
   461→    *,
   462→    trigger: str = "manual",
   463→) -> SynthesisMutationResult:
   464→    """Apply parsed synthesis result to the living plan.
   465→
   466→    1. Creates/updates synthesis-clusters in plan["clusters"]
   467→    2. Marks dismissed findings as synthesized_out skips
   468→    3. Reorders queue_order to group epic members by dependency_order
   469→    4. Updates epic_synthesis_meta with snapshot hash
   470→    """
   471→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   472→    now = utc_now()
   473→    result = SynthesisMutationResult()
   474→    result.strategy_summary = synthesis.strategy_summary
   475→
   476→    clusters = plan["clusters"]
   477→    skipped: dict = plan["skipped"]
   478→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   479→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   480→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   481→    result.synthesis_version = version
   482→
   483→    # --- Update/create synthesis-clusters ------------------------------------
   484→    for epic_data in sorted(synthesis.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   485→        raw_name = epic_data["name"]
   486→        epic_name = f"{EPIC_PREFIX}{raw_name}" if not raw_name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX) else raw_name
   487→
   488→        existing = clusters.get(epic_name)
   489→        if existing and existing.get("thesis"):
   490→            # Update existing synthesis-cluster
   491→            existing["thesis"] = epic_data["thesis"]
   492→            existing["direction"] = epic_data["direction"]
   493→            existing["root_cause"] = epic_data.get("root_cause", "")
   494→            existing["finding_ids"] = epic_data["finding_ids"]
   495→            existing["dismissed"] = epic_data.get("dismissed", [])
   496→            existing["agent_safe"] = epic_data.get("agent_safe", False)
   497→            existing["dependency_order"] = epic_data["dependency_order"]
   498→            existing["action_steps"] = epic_data.get("action_steps", [])
   499→            existing["updated_at"] = now
   500→            existing["synthesis_version"] = version
   501→            existing["description"] = epic_data["thesis"]
   502→            # Don't overwrite in_progress status from agent
   503→            if existing.get("status") != "in_progress":
   504→                existing["status"] = epic_data.get("status", "pending")
   505→            result.epics_updated += 1
   506→        else:
   507→            # Create new synthesis-cluster
   508→            cluster: Cluster = {
   509→                "name": epic_name,
   510→                "description": epic_data["thesis"],
   511→                "finding_ids": epic_data["finding_ids"],
   512→                "auto": True,
   513→                "cluster_key": f"epic::{epic_name}",
   514→                "action": f"desloppify plan focus {epic_name}",
   515→                "user_modified": False,
   516→                "created_at": now,
   517→                "updated_at": now,
   518→                # Epic fields
   519→                "thesis": epic_data["thesis"],
   520→                "direction": epic_data["direction"],
   521→                "root_cause": epic_data.get("root_cause", ""),
   522→                "supersedes": [],
   523→                "dismissed": epic_data.get("dismissed", []),
   524→                "agent_safe": epic_data.get("agent_safe", False),
   525→                "dependency_order": epic_data["dependency_order"],
   526→                "action_steps": epic_data.get("action_steps", []),
   527→                "source_clusters": [],
   528→                "status": epic_data.get("status", "pending"),
   529→                "synthesis_version": version,
   530→            }
   531→            clusters[epic_name] = cluster
   532→            result.epics_created += 1
   533→
   534→    # --- Dismiss findings ---------------------------------------------------
   535→    dismissed_ids: list[str] = []
   536→    for df in synthesis.dismissed_findings:
   537→        fid = df.finding_id
   538→        dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   539→        # Remove from queue, add to skipped as synthesized_out
   540→        if fid in order:
   541→            order.remove(fid)
   542→        skipped[fid] = {
   543→            "finding_id": fid,
   544→            "kind": "synthesized_out",
   545→            "reason": df.reason,
   546→            "note": f"Dismissed by epic synthesis v{version}",
   547→            "attestation": None,
   548→            "created_at": now,
   549→            "review_after": None,
   550→            "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   551→        }
   552→        result.findings_dismissed += 1
   553→
   554→    # Also handle per-epic dismissed lists
   555→    for epic_data in synthesis.epics:
   556→        for fid in epic_data.get("dismissed", []):
   557→            if fid not in dismissed_ids and fid in order:
   558→                order.remove(fid)
   559→                dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   560→                skipped[fid] = {
   561→                    "finding_id": fid,
   562→                    "kind": "synthesized_out",
   563→                    "reason": f"Dismissed by epic synthesis v{version}",
   564→                    "note": None,
   565→                    "attestation": None,
   566→                    "created_at": now,
   567→                    "review_after": None,
   568→                    "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   569→                }
   570→                result.findings_dismissed += 1
   571→
   572→    # --- Reorder queue: epic findings grouped by dependency_order -----------
   573→    epic_finding_ids: set[str] = set()
   574→    epic_ordered_ids: list[str] = []
   575→    for epic_data in sorted(synthesis.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   576→        for fid in epic_data["finding_ids"]:
   577→            if fid not in epic_finding_ids and fid not in dismissed_ids:
   578→                epic_finding_ids.add(fid)
   579→                epic_ordered_ids.append(fid)
   580→
   581→    # Rebuild order: epic items first (by dependency), then non-epic items in original order
   582→    non_epic_items = [fid for fid in order if fid not in epic_finding_ids]
   583→    # Insert epic items at the front (after synthesis::pending if present)
   584→    new_order: list[str] = []
   585→    # Keep synthesis::pending at front if present (it will be pruned next sync)
   586→    if SYNTHESIS_ID in non_epic_items:
   587→        non_epic_items.remove(SYNTHESIS_ID)
   588→    new_order.extend(epic_ordered_ids)
   589→    new_order.extend(non_epic_items)
   590→    order.clear()
   591→    order.extend(new_order)
   592→
   593→    # --- Update synthesis meta -----------------------------------------------
   594→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   595→    open_review_ids = sorted(
   596→        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   597→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   598→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   599→    )
   600→
   601→    plan["epic_synthesis_meta"] = {
   602→        "synthesized_ids": open_review_ids,
   603→        "last_run": now,
   604→        "version": version,
   605→        "dismissed_ids": dismissed_ids,
   606→        "finding_snapshot_hash": current_hash,
   607→        "strategy_summary": synthesis.strategy_summary,
   608→        "trigger": trigger,
   609→    }
   610→    plan["updated"] = now
   611→
   612→    return result
   613→
   614→
   615→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   616→# Top-level orchestrator
   617→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   618→
   619→@dataclass
   620→class SynthesisDeps:
   621→    """Injectable dependencies for the synthesis engine."""
   622→
   623→    llm_call: Any = None  # Callable[[str, str], str] — (system, user) -> response
   624→
   625→
   626→def synthesize_epics(
   627→    plan: PlanModel,
   628→    state: StateModel,
   629→    *,
   630→    deps: SynthesisDeps | None = None,
   631→    dry_run: bool = False,
   632→    trigger: str = "manual",
   633→) -> SynthesisMutationResult:
   634→    """Run epic synthesis: collect input, call LLM, apply results.
   635→
   636→    If ``dry_run`` is True, collects input and builds prompt but does not
   637→    call the LLM or mutate the plan.
   638→
   639→    If ``deps.llm_call`` is None, returns a dry-run result with the prompt.
   640→    """
   641→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   642→    si = collect_synthesis_input(plan, state)
   643→
   644→    prompt = build_synthesis_prompt(si)
   645→    valid_ids = set(si.open_findings.keys())
   646→
   647→    if dry_run or deps is None or deps.llm_call is None:
   648→        result = SynthesisMutationResult(dry_run=True)
   649→        result.strategy_summary = f"[dry-run] Prompt built with {len(si.open_findings)} findings"
   650→        return result
   651→
   652→    # Call LLM
   653→    try:
   654→        raw_response = deps.llm_call(_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
   655→        raw_json = json.loads(raw_response)
   656→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   657→        logger.error("Epic synthesis LLM response parse error: %s", exc)
   658→        result = SynthesisMutationResult()
   659→        result.strategy_summary = f"Synthesis failed: {exc}"
   660→        return result
   661→
   662→    synthesis = parse_synthesis_result(raw_json, valid_ids)
   663→    return apply_synthesis_to_plan(plan, state, synthesis, trigger=trigger)
   664→
   665→
   666→__all__ = [
   667→    "DismissedFinding",
   668→    "FINDING_ID_RE",
   669→    "SynthesisDeps",
   670→    "SynthesisInput",
   671→    "SynthesisMutationResult",
   672→    "SynthesisResult",
   673→    "apply_synthesis_to_plan",

+"""Epic synthesis engine — LLM-driven meta-plan for review findings.
+
+Clusters review findings by root cause, dismisses false positives,
+resolves contradictions, and orders by dependency. The synthesis is incremental:
+it updates existing synthesis-clusters rather than recreating from scratch.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import logging
+import re
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any
+
+from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import (
+    EPIC_PREFIX,
+    VALID_EPIC_DIRECTIONS,
+    Cluster,
+    PlanModel,
+    ensure_plan_defaults,
+    synthesis_clusters,
+)
+from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
+    SYNTHESIS_ID,
+    review_finding_snapshot_hash,
+)
+from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel, utc_now
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Finding-ID citation extraction
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+FINDING_ID_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z_]+::[a-f0-9]{8,}")
+
+
+def extract_finding_citations(text: str, valid_ids: set[str]) -> set[str]:
+    """Extract finding IDs cited in free text.
+
+    Matches full finding IDs (e.g. ``review::abcdef12``) or bare 8+ char
+    hex suffixes that correspond to a known finding.
+    """
+    cited: set[str] = set()
+    # Match full finding IDs
+    for match in FINDING_ID_RE.finditer(text):
+        candidate = match.group()
+        if candidate in valid_ids:
+            cited.add(candidate)
+    # Match 8+ char hex suffixes
+    for token in re.findall(r"[0-9a-f]{8,}", text):
+        for valid_id in valid_ids:
+            if valid_id.endswith("::" + token):
+                cited.add(valid_id)
+                break
+    return cited
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Completed-work helpers
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def last_real_review_timestamp(state: dict) -> str | None:
+    """ISO timestamp of most recent genuine review import (not manual override/scan reset)."""
+    REAL_MODES = {"holistic", "per_file", "trusted_internal", "attested_external"}
+    audit = state.get("assessment_import_audit", [])
+    if isinstance(audit, list):
+        for entry in reversed(audit):
+            if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("mode") in REAL_MODES:
+                ts = entry.get("timestamp")
+                if ts:
+                    return str(ts)
+    holistic = (state.get("review_cache") or {}).get("holistic")
+    if isinstance(holistic, dict):
+        return holistic.get("reviewed_at")
+    return None
+
+
+def detect_recurring_patterns(
+    open_findings: dict[str, dict],
+    resolved_findings: dict[str, dict],
+) -> dict[str, dict]:
+    """Detect dimensions with both resolved AND current open findings.
+
+    Returns ``{dimension: {"open": [ids], "resolved": [ids]}}``.
+    A dimension with both resolved and open findings signals a potential
+    loop — similar issues recur after previous fixes.
+    """
+    def _dimension(f: dict) -> str:
+        detail = f.get("detail", {})
+        if isinstance(detail, dict):
+            return detail.get("dimension", "")
+        return ""
+
+    open_by_dim: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for fid, f in open_findings.items():
+        dim = _dimension(f)
+        if dim:
+            open_by_dim.setdefault(dim, []).append(fid)
+
+    resolved_by_dim: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for fid, f in resolved_findings.items():
+        dim = _dimension(f)
+        if dim:
+            resolved_by_dim.setdefault(dim, []).append(fid)
+
+    recurring: dict[str, dict] = {}
+    for dim in set(open_by_dim) & set(resolved_by_dim):
+        recurring[dim] = {
+            "open": open_by_dim[dim],
+            "resolved": resolved_by_dim[dim],
+        }
+    return recurring
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Data types
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+@dataclass
+class SynthesisInput:
+    """All data the LLM needs to produce/update epics."""
+
+    open_findings: dict[str, dict]       # id -> finding (review + concerns)
+    mechanical_findings: dict[str, dict]  # id -> finding (non-review, for context)
+    existing_epics: dict[str, Cluster]    # current synthesis-clusters to update
+    dimension_scores: dict[str, Any]      # for context
+    new_since_last: set[str]             # finding IDs new since last synthesis
+    resolved_since_last: set[str]        # finding IDs resolved since last
+    previously_dismissed: list[str]      # IDs dismissed in prior synthesis
+    synthesis_version: int               # next version number
+    resolved_findings: dict[str, dict]   # full finding objects for resolved IDs
+    completed_clusters: list[dict]       # clusters completed since last synthesis
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DismissedFinding:
+    """A finding the LLM says doesn't make sense."""
+
+    finding_id: str
+    reason: str
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ContradictionNote:
+    """Record of a resolved contradiction."""
+
+    kept: str
+    dismissed: str
+    reason: str
+
+
+@dataclass
+class SynthesisResult:
+    """Parsed and validated LLM synthesis output."""
+
+    strategy_summary: str
+    epics: list[dict]
+    dismissed_findings: list[DismissedFinding] = field(default_factory=list)
+    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = field(default_factory=list)
+    priority_rationale: str = ""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class SynthesisMutationResult:
+    """What changed when synthesis was applied to the plan."""
+
+    epics_created: int = 0
+    epics_updated: int = 0
+    epics_completed: int = 0
+    findings_dismissed: int = 0
+    findings_reassigned: int = 0
+    strategy_summary: str = ""
+    synthesis_version: int = 0
+    dry_run: bool = False
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Input collection
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def collect_synthesis_input(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> SynthesisInput:
+    """Gather all data needed for the synthesis LLM prompt."""
+    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
+    findings = state.get("findings", {})
+    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
+    epics = synthesis_clusters(plan)
+
+    open_review: dict[str, dict] = {}
+    open_mechanical: dict[str, dict] = {}
+    for fid, f in findings.items():
+        if f.get("status") != "open":
+            continue
+        if f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns"):
+            open_review[fid] = f
+        else:
+            open_mechanical[fid] = f
+
+    synthesized_ids = set(meta.get("synthesized_ids", []))
+    current_review_ids = set(open_review.keys())
+    new_since = current_review_ids - synthesized_ids
+    resolved_since = synthesized_ids - current_review_ids
+    previously_dismissed = list(meta.get("dismissed_ids", []))
+    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
+
+    # Resolved finding objects (for REFLECT stage)
+    resolved_finding_objs = {
+        fid: findings[fid] for fid in resolved_since if fid in findings
+    }
+
+    # Completed clusters since last synthesis completion
+    last_completed = meta.get("last_completed_at", "")
+    all_completed: list[dict] = plan.get("completed_clusters", [])
+    if last_completed:
+        recent_completed = [
+            c for c in all_completed
+            if c.get("completed_at", "") > last_completed
+        ]
+    else:
+        recent_completed = list(all_completed)
+
+    return SynthesisInput(
+        open_findings=open_review,
+        mechanical_findings=open_mechanical,
+        existing_epics=dict(epics),
+        dimension_scores=state.get("dimension_scores", {}),
+        new_since_last=new_since,
+        resolved_since_last=resolved_since,
+        previously_dismissed=previously_dismissed,
+        synthesis_version=version,
+        resolved_findings=resolved_finding_objs,
+        completed_clusters=recent_completed,
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Prompt construction
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
+You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Your goal is to produce
+a coherent, prioritized strategy to address ALL open review findings.
+
+Your plan should:
+- Cluster findings by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
+- Give each cluster (epic) a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
+- Order epics by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
+- Dismiss findings that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
+- Mark which epics are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
+- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
+- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all findings coherently
+
+Available directions for epics: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
+
+Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
+- `desloppify plan queue` — view all items in priority order
+- `desloppify plan focus epic/<name>` — focus the queue on one epic
+- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
+- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
+- `desloppify plan done <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
+- `desloppify plan move <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
+- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
+- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
+- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review findings
+
+Your output defines the ENTIRE work plan. Findings not assigned to any epic
+will remain in the queue as individual items. Dismissed findings will be
+removed from the queue with your stated reason.
+
+Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
+{
+  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
+  "epics": [
+    {
+      "name": "slug-name",
+      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
+      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
+      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
+      "finding_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
+      "dismissed": ["id3"],
+      "agent_safe": true,
+      "dependency_order": 1,
+      "action_steps": ["step 1", "step 2"],
+      "status": "pending"
+    }
+  ],
+  "dismissed_findings": [
+    {"finding_id": "id", "reason": "why this finding doesn't make sense"}
+  ],
+  "contradiction_notes": [
+    {"kept": "finding_id", "dismissed": "finding_id", "reason": "why"}
+  ],
+  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is"
+}
+"""
+
+
+def build_synthesis_prompt(si: SynthesisInput) -> str:
+    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all finding data."""
+    parts: list[str] = []
+
+    # Section: existing epics
+    if si.existing_epics:
+        parts.append("## Existing Epics (update these, don't recreate)")
+        for name, epic in sorted(si.existing_epics.items()):
+            status = epic.get("status", "pending")
+            thesis = epic.get("thesis", "")
+            direction = epic.get("direction", "")
+            fids = epic.get("finding_ids", [])
+            parts.append(
+                f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
+                f"\n  Findings: {', '.join(fids[:10])}"
+                f"{'...' if len(fids) > 10 else ''}"
+            )
+        parts.append("")
+
+    # Section: what changed
+    if si.new_since_last:
+        parts.append(f"## New findings since last synthesis ({len(si.new_since_last)})")
+        for fid in sorted(si.new_since_last):
+            f = si.open_findings.get(fid, {})
+            parts.append(f"- {fid}: {f.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
+        parts.append("")
+
+    if si.resolved_since_last:
+        parts.append(f"## Resolved since last synthesis ({len(si.resolved_since_last)})")
+        for fid in sorted(si.resolved_since_last):
+            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
+        parts.append("")
+
+    # Section: all open review findings
+    parts.append(f"## All open review findings ({len(si.open_findings)})")
+    for fid, f in sorted(si.open_findings.items()):
+        detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
+        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
+        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
+        confidence = f.get("confidence", "medium")
+        file_path = f.get("file", "")
+        summary = f.get("summary", "")
+        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {fid}")
+        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
+        if dimension:
+            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
+        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
+        if suggestion:
+            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
+    parts.append("")
+
+    # Section: dimension scores for context
+    if si.dimension_scores:
+        parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
+        for name, data in sorted(si.dimension_scores.items()):
+            if isinstance(data, dict):
+                score = data.get("score", "?")
+                strict = data.get("strict", score)
+                issues = data.get("issues", 0)
+                parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
+        parts.append("")
+
+    # Section: previously dismissed
+    if si.previously_dismissed:
+        parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(si.previously_dismissed)})")
+        parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
+        for fid in si.previously_dismissed:
+            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
+        parts.append("")
+
+    return "\n".join(parts)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Result parsing
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def parse_synthesis_result(raw: dict, valid_ids: set[str]) -> SynthesisResult:
+    """Parse and validate raw LLM output into a SynthesisResult.
+
+    Invalid finding IDs are silently dropped from epics and dismissals.
+    """
+    strategy_summary = str(raw.get("strategy_summary", ""))
+
+    epics: list[dict] = []
+    for raw_epic in raw.get("epics", []):
+        if not isinstance(raw_epic, dict):
+            continue
+        name = str(raw_epic.get("name", "")).strip()
+        if not name:
+            continue
+        # Validate direction
+        direction = str(raw_epic.get("direction", "simplify")).strip()
+        if direction not in VALID_EPIC_DIRECTIONS:
+            direction = "simplify"
+        # Filter to valid finding IDs
+        finding_ids = [
+            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("finding_ids", [])
+            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
+        ]
+        dismissed = [
+            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("dismissed", [])
+            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
+        ]
+        action_steps = [
+            str(s) for s in raw_epic.get("action_steps", [])
+            if isinstance(s, str)
+        ]
+
+        epics.append({
+            "name": name,
+            "thesis": str(raw_epic.get("thesis", "")),
+            "direction": direction,
+            "root_cause": str(raw_epic.get("root_cause", "")),
+            "finding_ids": finding_ids,
+            "dismissed": dismissed,
+            "agent_safe": bool(raw_epic.get("agent_safe", False)),
+            "dependency_order": int(raw_epic.get("dependency_order", 999)),
+            "action_steps": action_steps,
+            "status": str(raw_epic.get("status", "pending")),
+        })
+
+    dismissed_findings: list[DismissedFinding] = []
+    for d in raw.get("dismissed_findings", []):
+        if not isinstance(d, dict):
+            continue
+        fid = str(d.get("finding_id", ""))
+        if fid in valid_ids:
+            dismissed_findings.append(
+                DismissedFinding(finding_id=fid, reason=str(d.get("reason", "")))
+            )
+
+    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = []
+    for c in raw.get("contradiction_notes", []):
+        if not isinstance(c, dict):
+            continue
+        contradiction_notes.append(ContradictionNote(
+            kept=str(c.get("kept", "")),
+            dismissed=str(c.get("dismissed", "")),
+            reason=str(c.get("reason", "")),
+        ))
+
+    priority_rationale = str(raw.get("priority_rationale", ""))
+
+    return SynthesisResult(
+        strategy_summary=strategy_summary,
+        epics=epics,
+        dismissed_findings=dismissed_findings,
+        contradiction_notes=contradiction_notes,
+        priority_rationale=priority_rationale,
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Plan mutation
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def apply_synthesis_to_plan(
+    plan: PlanModel,
+    state: StateModel,
+    synthesis: SynthesisResult,
+    *,
+    trigger: str = "manual",
+) -> SynthesisMutationResult:
+    """Apply parsed synthesis result to the living plan.
+
+    1. Creates/updates synthesis-clusters in plan["clusters"]
+    2. Marks dismissed findings as synthesized_out skips
+    3. Reorders queue_order to group epic members by dependency_order
+    4. Updates epic_synthesis_meta with snapshot hash
+    """
+    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
+    now = utc_now()
+    result = SynthesisMutationResult()
+    result.strategy_summary = synthesis.strategy_summary
+
+    clusters = plan["clusters"]
+    skipped: dict = plan["skipped"]
+    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
+    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
+    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
+    result.synthesis_version = version
+
+    # --- Update/create synthesis-clusters ------------------------------------
+    for epic_data in sorted(synthesis.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
+        raw_name = epic_data["name"]
+        epic_name = f"{EPIC_PREFIX}{raw_name}" if not raw_name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX) else raw_name
+
+        existing = clusters.get(epic_name)
+        if existing and existing.get("thesis"):
+            # Update existing synthesis-cluster
+            existing["thesis"] = epic_data["thesis"]
+            existing["direction"] = epic_data["direction"]
+            existing["root_cause"] = epic_data.get("root_cause", "")
+            existing["finding_ids"] = epic_data["finding_ids"]
+            existing["dismissed"] = epic_data.get("dismissed", [])
+            existing["agent_safe"] = epic_data.get("agent_safe", False)
+            existing["dependency_order"] = epic_data["dependency_order"]
+            existing["action_steps"] = epic_data.get("action_steps", [])
+            existing["updated_at"] = now
+            existing["synthesis_version"] = version
+            existing["description"] = epic_data["thesis"]
+            # Don't overwrite in_progress status from agent
+            if existing.get("status") != "in_progress":
+                existing["status"] = epic_data.get("status", "pending")
+            result.epics_updated += 1
+        else:
+            # Create new synthesis-cluster
+            cluster: Cluster = {
+                "name": epic_name,
+                "description": epic_data["thesis"],
+                "finding_ids": epic_data["finding_ids"],
+                "auto": True,
+                "cluster_key": f"epic::{epic_name}",
+                "action": f"desloppify plan focus {epic_name}",
+                "user_modified": False,
+                "created_at": now,
+                "updated_at": now,
+                # Epic fields
+                "thesis": epic_data["thesis"],
+                "direction": epic_data["direction"],
+                "root_cause": epic_data.get("root_cause", ""),
+                "supersedes": [],
+                "dismissed": epic_data.get("dismissed", []),
+                "agent_safe": epic_data.get("agent_safe", False),
+                "dependency_order": epic_data["dependency_order"],
+                "action_steps": epic_data.get("action_steps", []),
+                "source_clusters": [],
+                "status": epic_data.get("status", "pending"),
+                "synthesis_version": version,
+            }
+            clusters[epic_name] = cluster
+            result.epics_created += 1
+
+    # --- Dismiss findings ---------------------------------------------------
+    dismissed_ids: list[str] = []
+    for df in synthesis.dismissed_findings:
+        fid = df.finding_id
+        dismissed_ids.append(fid)
+        # Remove from queue, add to skipped as synthesized_out
+        if fid in order:
+            order.remove(fid)
+        skipped[fid] = {
+            "finding_id": fid,
+            "kind": "synthesized_out",
+            "reason": df.reason,
+            "note": f"Dismissed by epic synthesis v{version}",
+            "attestation": None,
+            "created_at": now,
+            "review_after": None,
+            "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
+        }
+        result.findings_dismissed += 1
+
+    # Also handle per-epic dismissed lists
+    for epic_data in synthesis.epics:
+        for fid in epic_data.get("dismissed", []):
+            if fid not in dismissed_ids and fid in order:
+                order.remove(fid)
+                dismissed_ids.append(fid)
+                skipped[fid] = {
+                    "finding_id": fid,
+                    "kind": "synthesized_out",
+                    "reason": f"Dismissed by epic synthesis v{version}",
+                    "note": None,
+                    "attestation": None,
+                    "created_at": now,
+                    "review_after": None,
+                    "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
+                }
+                result.findings_dismissed += 1
+
+    # --- Reorder queue: epic findings grouped by dependency_order -----------
+    epic_finding_ids: set[str] = set()
+    epic_ordered_ids: list[str] = []
+    for epic_data in sorted(synthesis.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
+        for fid in epic_data["finding_ids"]:
+            if fid not in epic_finding_ids and fid not in dismissed_ids:
+                epic_finding_ids.add(fid)
+                epic_ordered_ids.append(fid)
+
+    # Rebuild order: epic items first (by dependency), then non-epic items in original order
+    non_epic_items = [fid for fid in order if fid not in epic_finding_ids]
+    # Insert epic items at the front (after synthesis::pending if present)
+    new_order: list[str] = []
+    # Keep synthesis::pending at front if present (it will be pruned next sync)
+    if SYNTHESIS_ID in non_epic_items:
+        non_epic_items.remove(SYNTHESIS_ID)
+    new_order.extend(epic_ordered_ids)
+    new_order.extend(non_epic_items)
+    order.clear()
+    order.extend(new_order)
+
+    # --- Update synthesis meta -----------------------------------------------
+    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
+    open_review_ids = sorted(
+        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
+        if f.get("status") == "open"
+        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
+    )
+
+    plan["epic_synthesis_meta"] = {
+        "synthesized_ids": open_review_ids,
+        "last_run": now,
+        "version": version,
+        "dismissed_ids": dismissed_ids,
+        "finding_snapshot_hash": current_hash,
+        "strategy_summary": synthesis.strategy_summary,
+        "trigger": trigger,
+    }
+    plan["updated"] = now
+
+    return result
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Top-level orchestrator
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+@dataclass
+class SynthesisDeps:
+    """Injectable dependencies for the synthesis engine."""
+
+    llm_call: Any = None  # Callable[[str, str], str] — (system, user) -> response
+
+
+def synthesize_epics(
+    plan: PlanModel,
+    state: StateModel,
+    *,
+    deps: SynthesisDeps | None = None,
+    dry_run: bool = False,
+    trigger: str = "manual",
+) -> SynthesisMutationResult:
+    """Run epic synthesis: collect input, call LLM, apply results.
+
+    If ``dry_run`` is True, collects input and builds prompt but does not
+    call the LLM or mutate the plan.
+
+    If ``deps.llm_call`` is None, returns a dry-run result with the prompt.
+    """
+    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
+    si = collect_synthesis_input(plan, state)
+
+    prompt = build_synthesis_prompt(si)
+    valid_ids = set(si.open_findings.keys())
+
+    if dry_run or deps is None or deps.llm_call is None:
+        result = SynthesisMutationResult(dry_run=True)
+        result.strategy_summary = f"[dry-run] Prompt built with {len(si.open_findings)} findings"
+        return result
+
+    # Call LLM
+    try:
+        raw_response = deps.llm_call(_SYNTHESIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
+        raw_json = json.loads(raw_response)
+    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        logger.error("Epic synthesis LLM response parse error: %s", exc)
+        result = SynthesisMutationResult()
+        result.strategy_summary = f"Synthesis failed: {exc}"
+        return result
+
+    synthesis = parse_synthesis_result(raw_json, valid_ids)
+    return apply_synthesis_to_plan(plan, state, synthesis, trigger=trigger)
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "DismissedFinding",
+    "FINDING_ID_RE",
+    "SynthesisDeps",
+    "SynthesisInput",
+    "SynthesisMutationResult",
+    "SynthesisResult",
+    "apply_synthesis_to_plan",
+    "build_synthesis_prompt",
+    "collect_synthesis_input",
+    "detect_recurring_patterns",
+    "extract_finding_citations",
+    "last_real_review_timestamp",
+    "parse_synthesis_result",
+    "synthesize_epics",
+]

1→"""Sync subjective dimensions into the plan queue.
     2→
     3→Two independent sync functions:
     4→
     5→- **sync_unscored_dimensions** — prepend never-scored (placeholder) dimensions
     6→  to the *front* of the queue unconditionally (onboarding priority).
     7→- **sync_stale_dimensions** — append stale (previously-scored) dimensions to
     8→  the *back* of the queue when no objective items remain.
     9→"""
    10→
    11→from __future__ import annotations
    12→
    13→import hashlib
    14→from dataclasses import dataclass, field
    15→
    16→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import PlanModel, ensure_plan_defaults
    17→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    18→
    19→SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX = "subjective::"
    20→SYNTHESIS_ID = "synthesis::pending"
    21→
    22→
    23→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    24→# Result dataclasses
    25→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    26→
    27→@dataclass
    28→class StaleDimensionSyncResult:
    29→    """What changed during a stale-dimension sync."""
    30→
    31→    injected: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    32→    pruned: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    33→
    34→    @property
    35→    def changes(self) -> int:
    36→        return len(self.injected) + len(self.pruned)
    37→
    38→
    39→@dataclass
    40→class UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
    41→    """What changed during an unscored-dimension sync."""
    42→
    43→    injected: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    44→    pruned: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    45→
    46→    @property
    47→    def changes(self) -> int:
    48→        return len(self.injected) + len(self.pruned)
    49→
    50→
    51→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    52→# ID helpers
    53→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    54→
    55→def _current_stale_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    56→    """Return the set of ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are currently stale."""
    57→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
    58→    from desloppify.engine.planning.scorecard_projection import (
    59→        scorecard_subjective_entries,
    60→    )
    61→
    62→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
    63→    if not dim_scores:
    64→        return set()
    65→
    66→    stale: set[str] = set()
    67→    for entry in scorecard_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores):
    68→        if not entry.get("stale"):
    69→            continue
    70→        dim_key = entry.get("dimension_key", "")
    71→        if dim_key:
    72→            stale.add(f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}")
    73→    return stale
    74→
    75→
    76→def _current_unscored_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    77→    """Return the set of ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are currently unscored (placeholder).
    78→
    79→    Checks ``subjective_assessments`` directly because
    80→    ``scorecard_subjective_entries`` filters out placeholder dimensions
    81→    (they are hidden from the scorecard display).
    82→    """
    83→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
    84→
    85→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments")
    86→    if not isinstance(assessments, dict) or not assessments:
    87→        return set()
    88→
    89→    unscored: set[str] = set()
    90→    for dim_key, payload in assessments.items():
    91→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
    92→            continue
    93→        if not payload.get("placeholder"):
    94→            continue
    95→        if dim_key:
    96→            unscored.add(f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}")
    97→    return unscored
    98→
    99→
   100→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   101→# Unscored dimension sync (front of queue, unconditional)
   102→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   103→
   104→def sync_unscored_dimensions(
   105→    plan: PlanModel,
   106→    state: StateModel,
   107→) -> UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
   108→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions.
   109→
   110→    1. **Prune** — remove ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are
   111→       no longer unscored AND not stale (avoids pruning stale IDs — that is
   112→       ``sync_stale_dimensions``' responsibility).
   113→    2. **Inject** — unconditionally prepend currently-unscored IDs to the
   114→       *front* of ``queue_order`` so initial reviews are the first priority.
   115→    """
   116→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   117→    result = UnscoredDimensionSyncResult()
   118→    unscored_ids = _current_unscored_ids(state)
   119→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   120→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   121→
   122→    # --- Cleanup: prune subjective IDs that are no longer unscored --------
   123→    # Only prune IDs that are neither unscored nor stale (stale sync owns those).
   124→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   125→        fid for fid in order
   126→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   127→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   128→        and fid not in stale_ids
   129→    ]
   130→    for fid in to_remove:
   131→        order.remove(fid)
   132→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   133→
   134→    # --- Inject: prepend unscored IDs to front ----------------------------
   135→    existing = set(order)
   136→    for uid in reversed(sorted(unscored_ids)):
   137→        if uid not in existing:
   138→            order.insert(0, uid)
   139→            result.injected.append(uid)
   140→
   141→    return result
   142→
   143→
   144→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   145→# Stale dimension sync (back of queue, conditional)
   146→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   147→
   148→def sync_stale_dimensions(
   149→    plan: PlanModel,
   150→    state: StateModel,
   151→) -> StaleDimensionSyncResult:
   152→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with stale subjective dimensions.
   153→
   154→    1. Remove any ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are no
   155→       longer stale and not unscored (avoids pruning IDs owned by
   156→       ``sync_unscored_dimensions``).
   157→    2. If no objective items remain after cleanup, inject all currently-stale
   158→       dimension IDs so the plan surfaces them as actionable work.
   159→    """
   160→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   161→    result = StaleDimensionSyncResult()
   162→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   163→    unscored_ids = _current_unscored_ids(state)
   164→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   165→
   166→    # --- Cleanup: prune resolved subjective IDs --------------------------
   167→    # Only prune IDs that are neither stale nor unscored.
   168→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   169→        fid for fid in order
   170→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   171→        and fid not in stale_ids
   172→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   173→    ]
   174→    for fid in to_remove:
   175→        order.remove(fid)
   176→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   177→
   178→    # --- Inject: populate when no objective items remain -----------------
   179→    has_real_items = any(fid for fid in order if not fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX))
   180→    if not has_real_items and stale_ids:
   181→        existing = set(order)
   182→        for sid in sorted(stale_ids):
   183→            if sid not in existing:
   184→                order.append(sid)
   185→                result.injected.append(sid)
   186→
   187→    return result
   188→
   189→
   190→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   191→# Synthesis snapshot hash + sync
   192→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   193→
   194→def review_finding_snapshot_hash(state: StateModel) -> str:
   195→    """Hash open review finding IDs to detect changes.
   196→
   197→    Returns empty string when there are no open review findings.
   198→    """
   199→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   200→    review_ids = sorted(
   201→        fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   202→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   203→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   204→    )
   205→    if not review_ids:
   206→        return ""
   207→    return hashlib.sha256("|".join(review_ids).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
   208→
   209→
   210→@dataclass
   211→class SynthesisSyncResult:
   212→    """What changed during a synthesis sync."""
   213→
   214→    injected: bool = False
   215→    pruned: bool = False
   216→
   217→    @property
   218→    def changes(self) -> int:
   219→        return int(self.injected) + int(self.pruned)
   220→
   221→
   222→def sync_synthesis_needed(
   223→    plan: PlanModel,
   224→    state: StateModel,
   225→) -> SynthesisSyncResult:
   226→    """Inject ``synthesis::pending`` at front of queue when review findings change.
   227→
   228→    Never auto-prunes — only explicit completion (``_apply_completion``) removes it.
   229→    """
   230→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   231→    result = SynthesisSyncResult()
   232→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   233→    meta = plan.get("epic_synthesis_meta", {})
   234→    already_present = SYNTHESIS_ID in order
   235→
   236→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   237→    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
   238→
   239→    # If hash changed and not already present, inject at front
   240→    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash and not already_present:
   241→        order.insert(0, SYNTHESIS_ID)
   242→        result.injected = True
   243→
   244→    # Never auto-prune: synthesis::pending is only removed by explicit completion
   245→
   246→    return result
   247→
   248→

   250→    "SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX",
   251→    "SYNTHESIS_ID",

1→"""Queue-policy helpers shared by planning render/select modules."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from dataclasses import dataclass
     6→from typing import Any
     7→
     8→from desloppify.engine.work_queue import (

    13→
    14→
    15→def _subjective_threshold(state: dict[str, Any], *, default: float = 95.0) -> float:
    16→    config = state.get("config", {})
    17→    raw_target = default
    18→    if isinstance(config, dict):
    19→        raw_target = config.get("target_strict_score", default)
    20→    try:
    21→        value = float(raw_target)
    22→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
    23→        value = default
    24→    return max(0.0, min(100.0, value))
    25→
    26→
    27→@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
    28→class OpenPlanQueuePolicy:
    29→    tier: int | None = None
    30→    count: int | None = None
    31→    scan_path: str | None = None
    32→    include_subjective: bool = True
    33→    no_tier_fallback: bool = True
    34→
    35→
    36→def build_open_plan_queue(
    37→    state: dict[str, Any],
    38→    policy: OpenPlanQueuePolicy | None = None,
    39→) -> WorkQueueResult:
    40→    """Build one open-status queue with consistent planning policy defaults."""
    41→    policy = policy or OpenPlanQueuePolicy()
    42→    resolved_scan_path: str | None
    43→    if isinstance(policy.scan_path, str):
    44→        resolved_scan_path = policy.scan_path
    45→    else:
    46→        raw_state_path = state.get("scan_path")
    47→        resolved_scan_path = raw_state_path if isinstance(raw_state_path, str) else None
    48→    return build_work_queue(
    49→        state,
    50→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
    51→            tier=policy.tier,

+def _count_open_subjective_queue_items(

+    count = 0
+    for item in queue.get("items", []):
+        if item.get("kind") != "subjective_dimension":
+            continue

+            count += 1

+        item_dim = _normalize_dimension_key(raw_dim)

   214→def validate_plan(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   215→    """Raise ValueError when plan invariants are violated."""
   216→    if not isinstance(plan.get("version"), int):

   218→    if not isinstance(plan.get("queue_order"), list):

  1557→  1557→+"""Centralized execution policy for review batch orchestration."""
  1558→  1558→+
  1559→  1559→+from __future__ import annotations
  1560→  1560→+
  1561→  1561→+import math

  1570→  1570→+from desloppify.core._internal.coercions import (

  1573→  1573→+from desloppify.core._internal.coercions import (

  1576→  1576→+
  1577→  1577→+DEFAULT_BATCH_STALL_KILL_SECONDS = 120
  1578→  1578→+
  1579→  1579→+
  1580→  1580→+@dataclass(frozen=True)
  1581→  1581→+class BatchRunPolicy:
  1582→  1582→+    """Resolved runtime knobs for `review --run-batches` execution."""
  1583→  1583→+
  1584→  1584→+    run_parallel: bool
  1585→  1585→+    max_parallel_batches: int
  1586→  1586→+    heartbeat_seconds: float
  1587→  1587→+    batch_timeout_seconds: int
  1588→  1588→+    batch_max_retries: int
  1589→  1589→+    batch_retry_backoff_seconds: float
  1590→  1590→+    stall_warning_seconds: int
  1591→  1591→+    stall_kill_seconds: int
  1592→  1592→+
  1593→  1593→+    def max_parallel_workers(self, total_batches: int) -> int:
  1594→  1594→+        if total_batches <= 0:
  1595→  1595→+            return 1
  1596→  1596→+        if self.run_parallel:
  1597→  1597→+            return min(total_batches, self.max_parallel_batches)
  1598→  1598→+        return 1
  1599→  1599→+
  1600→  1600→+    def worst_case_minutes(self, total_batches: int) -> int:
  1601→  1601→+        waves = math.ceil(total_batches / self.max_parallel_workers(total_batches))
  1602→  1602→+        return max(1, math.ceil((waves * self.batch_timeout_seconds) / 60))
  1603→  1603→+
  1604→  1604→+
  1605→  1605→+def resolve_batch_run_policy(args) -> BatchRunPolicy:
  1606→  1606→+    """Build one canonical policy object from CLI args."""
  1607→  1607→+    return BatchRunPolicy(
  1608→  1608→+        run_parallel=bool(getattr(args, "parallel", False)),
  1609→  1609→+        max_parallel_batches=_coerce_positive_int(
  1610→  1610→+            getattr(args, "max_parallel_batches", None),
  1611→  1611→+            default=3,
  1612→  1612→+            minimum=1,
  1613→  1613→+        ),
  1614→  1614→+        heartbeat_seconds=_coerce_positive_float(
  1615→  1615→+            getattr(args, "batch_heartbeat_seconds", None),
  1616→  1616→+            default=15.0,
  1617→  1617→+            minimum=0.1,
  1618→  1618→+        ),
  1619→  1619→+        batch_timeout_seconds=_coerce_positive_int(
  1620→  1620→+            getattr(args, "batch_timeout_seconds", None),
  1621→  1621→+            default=2 * 60 * 60,
  1622→  1622→+            minimum=1,
  1623→  1623→+        ),
  1624→  1624→+        batch_max_retries=_coerce_positive_int(
  1625→  1625→+            getattr(args, "batch_max_retries", None),
  1626→  1626→+            default=1,
  1627→  1627→+            minimum=0,
  1628→  1628→+        ),
  1629→  1629→+        batch_retry_backoff_seconds=_coerce_non_negative_float(
  1630→  1630→+            getattr(args, "batch_retry_backoff_seconds", None),
  1631→  1631→+            default=2.0,
  1632→  1632→+        ),
  1633→  1633→+        stall_warning_seconds=_coerce_non_negative_int(
  1634→  1634→+            getattr(args, "batch_stall_warning_seconds", None),
  1635→  1635→+            default=0,
  1636→  1636→+        ),
  1637→  1637→+        stall_kill_seconds=_coerce_non_negative_int(
  1638→  1638→+            getattr(args, "batch_stall_kill_seconds", None),
  1639→  1639→+            default=DEFAULT_BATCH_STALL_KILL_SECONDS,
  1640→  1640→+        ),
  1641→  1641→+    )
  1642→  1642→+

    19→def _remove_id_from_lists(plan: PlanModel, finding_id: str) -> None:
    20→    """Remove a finding ID from queue_order and skipped."""
    21→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
    22→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan.get("skipped", {})
    23→    if finding_id in order:
    24→        order.remove(finding_id)
    25→    skipped.pop(finding_id, None)
    26→
    27→
    28→def _resolve_position(
    29→    order: list[str],
    30→    position: str,
    31→    target: str | None = None,
    32→    offset: int | None = None,
    33→    finding_ids: list[str] | None = None,
    34→) -> int:
    35→    """Resolve a position specifier to an insertion index.
    36→
    37→    *finding_ids* are the IDs being moved — used to calculate relative
    38→    positions when they already exist in the list.
    39→    """
    40→    moving = set(finding_ids or [])
    41→
    42→    if position == "top":
    43→        return 0
    44→    if position == "bottom":
    45→        return len(order)
    46→
    47→    if position in {"before", "after"} and target:
    48→        return _resolve_relative_position(order, moving, position=position, target=target)
    49→
    50→    if position in {"up", "down"} and offset is not None:
    51→        return _resolve_offset_position(
    52→            order,
    53→            moving,
    54→            position=position,
    55→            offset=offset,
    56→            finding_ids=finding_ids,
    57→        )
    58→
    59→    return len(order)
    60→
    61→
    62→def _resolve_relative_position(
    63→    order: list[str],
    64→    moving: set[str],
    65→    *,
    66→    position: str,
    67→    target: str,
    68→) -> int:
    69→    for i, item_id in enumerate(order):
    70→        if item_id == target and item_id not in moving:
    71→            return i if position == "before" else i + 1
    72→    return 0 if position == "before" else len(order)
    73→
    74→
    75→def _find_index(items: list[str], target: str) -> int | None:
    76→    for i, item_id in enumerate(items):
    77→        if item_id == target:
    78→            return i
    79→    return None
    80→
    81→
    82→def _resolve_offset_position(
    83→    order: list[str],
    84→    moving: set[str],
    85→    *,
    86→    position: str,
    87→    offset: int,
    88→    finding_ids: list[str] | None,
    89→) -> int:
    90→    if not finding_ids:
    91→        return 0 if position == "up" else len(order)
    92→    first_id = finding_ids[0]
    93→    clean_order = [x for x in order if x not in moving]
    94→    current_idx = _find_index(clean_order, first_id)
    95→    if current_idx is None:
    96→        if position == "up":
    97→            return max(0, len(clean_order) - offset)
    98→        return len(clean_order)
    99→    if position == "up":
   100→        return max(0, current_idx - offset)
   101→    return min(len(clean_order), current_idx + offset)

   107→
   108→def move_items(
   109→    plan: PlanModel,
   110→    finding_ids: list[str],
   111→    position: str,
   112→    target: str | None = None,
   113→    offset: int | None = None,
   114→) -> int:
   115→    """Move finding IDs to a position in queue_order. Returns count moved."""
   116→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   117→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   118→
   119→    # Remove from skipped if present
   120→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan.get("skipped", {})
   121→    for fid in finding_ids:
   122→        skipped.pop(fid, None)
   123→
   124→    # Remove from current position in order
   125→    for fid in finding_ids:
   126→        if fid in order:
   127→            order.remove(fid)
   128→
   129→    # Resolve insertion point
   130→    idx = _resolve_position(order, position, target, offset, finding_ids)
   131→
   132→    # Insert in original order
   133→    for i, fid in enumerate(finding_ids):
   134→        order.insert(idx + i, fid)
   135→
   136→    return len(finding_ids)

   143→def skip_items(
   144→    plan: PlanModel,
   145→    finding_ids: list[str],
   146→    *,
   147→    kind: str = "temporary",
   148→    reason: str | None = None,
   149→    note: str | None = None,
   150→    attestation: str | None = None,
   151→    review_after: int | None = None,
   152→    scan_count: int = 0,
   153→) -> int:
   154→    """Move finding IDs to the skipped dict. Returns count skipped."""
   155→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   156→    now = utc_now()
   157→    count = 0
   158→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
   159→    for fid in finding_ids:
   160→        _remove_id_from_lists(plan, fid)
   161→        skipped[fid] = {
   162→            "finding_id": fid,
   163→            "kind": kind,
   164→            "reason": reason,
   165→            "note": note,
   166→            "attestation": attestation,
   167→            "created_at": now,
   168→            "review_after": review_after,
   169→            "skipped_at_scan": scan_count,
   170→        }
   171→        count += 1
   172→    return count
   173→
   174→
   175→def unskip_items(
   176→    plan: PlanModel, finding_ids: list[str]
   177→) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
   178→    """Bring finding IDs back from skipped to the end of queue_order.
   179→
   180→    Returns ``(count_unskipped, permanent_ids_needing_state_reopen)``
   181→    where the second list contains IDs that were permanent or false_positive
   182→    and need their state-layer status reopened by the caller.
   183→    """
   184→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   185→    count = 0
   186→    need_reopen: list[str] = []
   187→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
   188→    for fid in finding_ids:
   189→        entry = skipped.pop(fid, None)
   190→        if entry is not None:
   191→            if entry.get("kind") in ("permanent", "false_positive"):
   192→                need_reopen.append(fid)
   193→            if fid not in plan["queue_order"]:
   194→                plan["queue_order"].append(fid)
   195→            count += 1
   196→    return count, need_reopen
   197→
   198→
   199→def resurface_stale_skips(
   200→    plan: PlanModel, current_scan_count: int
   201→) -> list[str]:
   202→    """Move temporary skips past their review_after threshold back to queue.
   203→
   204→    Returns list of resurfaced finding IDs.
   205→    """
   206→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   207→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
   208→    resurfaced: list[str] = []
   209→    for fid in list(skipped):
   210→        entry = skipped[fid]
   211→        if entry.get("kind") != "temporary":
   212→            continue
   213→        review_after = entry.get("review_after")
   214→        if review_after is None:
   215→            continue
   216→        skipped_at = entry.get("skipped_at_scan", 0)
   217→        if current_scan_count >= skipped_at + review_after:
   218→            skipped.pop(fid)
   219→            if fid not in plan["queue_order"]:
   220→                plan["queue_order"].append(fid)
   221→            resurfaced.append(fid)
   222→    return resurfaced

   259→def create_cluster(
   260→    plan: PlanModel,
   261→    name: str,

   263→    action: str | None = None,
   264→) -> Cluster:
   265→    """Create a named cluster. Raises ValueError if it already exists."""
   266→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   267→    if name.startswith("auto/"):
   268→        raise ValueError(
   269→            f"Cluster names starting with 'auto/' are reserved for auto-clusters: {name!r}"
   270→        )
   271→    if name.startswith("epic/"):

   274→        )

   276→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {name!r} already exists")
   277→    now = utc_now()
   278→    cluster: Cluster = {
   279→        "name": name,
   280→        "description": description,
   281→        "finding_ids": [],
   282→        "created_at": now,
   283→        "updated_at": now,
   284→        "auto": False,
   285→        "cluster_key": "",
   286→        "action": action,
   287→        "user_modified": False,

   293→def add_to_cluster(
   294→    plan: PlanModel, cluster_name: str, finding_ids: list[str]
   295→) -> int:
   296→    """Add finding IDs to a cluster. Returns count added."""
   297→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   298→    cluster = plan["clusters"].get(cluster_name)
   299→    if cluster is None:
   300→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {cluster_name!r} does not exist")
   301→
   302→    member_ids: list[str] = cluster["finding_ids"]
   303→    count = 0
   304→    now = utc_now()
   305→    for fid in finding_ids:
   306→        if fid not in member_ids:
   307→            member_ids.append(fid)
   308→            count += 1
   309→        # Update override to track cluster membership
   310→        overrides = plan["overrides"]
   311→        if fid not in overrides:
   312→            overrides[fid] = {"finding_id": fid, "created_at": now}
   313→        overrides[fid]["cluster"] = cluster_name
   314→        overrides[fid]["updated_at"] = now
   315→
   316→    cluster["updated_at"] = now
   317→    return count

   319→
   320→def remove_from_cluster(
   321→    plan: PlanModel, cluster_name: str, finding_ids: list[str]
   322→) -> int:
   323→    """Remove finding IDs from a cluster. Returns count removed."""
   324→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   325→    cluster = plan["clusters"].get(cluster_name)

   327→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {cluster_name!r} does not exist")
   328→
   329→    member_ids: list[str] = cluster["finding_ids"]

   332→    for fid in finding_ids:

   336→        # Clear cluster from override

   338→        if override and override.get("cluster") == cluster_name:

   342→    # Mark auto-clusters as user_modified when items are manually removed
   343→    if count > 0 and cluster.get("auto"):

   350→def delete_cluster(plan: PlanModel, name: str) -> list[str]:
   351→    """Delete a cluster and clear cluster refs from overrides. Returns orphaned IDs."""
   352→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   353→    cluster = plan["clusters"].pop(name, None)
   354→    if cluster is None:
   355→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {name!r} does not exist")
   356→
   357→    orphaned = list(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   358→    now = utc_now()
   359→    for fid in orphaned:
   360→        override = plan["overrides"].get(fid)
   361→        if override and override.get("cluster") == name:
   362→            override["cluster"] = None
   363→            override["updated_at"] = now
   364→
   365→    if plan.get("active_cluster") == name:
   366→        plan["active_cluster"] = None
   367→
   368→    return orphaned

   375→    target: str | None = None,

   395→def set_focus(plan: PlanModel, cluster_name: str) -> None:

   413→def reset_plan(plan: PlanModel) -> None:
   414→    """Reset plan to empty state, preserving version and created timestamp."""
   415→    created = plan.get("created", utc_now())
   416→    plan.clear()
   417→    for k, v in empty_plan().items():
   418→        plan[k] = v
   419→    plan["created"] = created

   422→def purge_ids(plan: PlanModel, finding_ids: list[str]) -> int:
   423→    """Remove finding IDs from the plan entirely.
   424→
   425→    Cleans queue_order, skipped, and all cluster memberships.
   426→    Does NOT touch overrides (descriptions/notes are kept for history).
   427→    Returns count of IDs that were actually present somewhere.
   428→    """
   429→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   430→    found = 0
   431→
   432→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   433→    skipped: dict[str, SkipEntry] = plan["skipped"]
   434→    for fid in finding_ids:
   435→        was_present = False
   436→        if fid in order:
   437→            order.remove(fid)
   438→            was_present = True
   439→        if fid in skipped:
   440→            skipped.pop(fid)
   441→            was_present = True
   442→        for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   443→            ids = cluster.get("finding_ids", [])
   444→            if fid in ids:
   445→                ids.remove(fid)
   446→                was_present = True
   447→        if was_present:
   448→            found += 1
   449→
   450→    return found

     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations

     6→import logging

    13→from desloppify.core.errors import PlanLoadError

    16→    PlanModel,
